title: Countersign Intent
description: A signed statement of what an agent wants to do, awaiting human countersignature. Countersign spec v0.1.

agent.description: The requesting agent's identity and signing key.

public_key.description: base64url-encoded raw 32-byte ed25519 public key (43 chars, no padding).

action.description: Machine-oriented name of the action, e.g. "billing.refund".

summary.description: Human-oriented one-line description shown to the approver.

approvers.description: Who may countersign, as channel:address strings.

quorum.description: Number of distinct approvers whose approve is required (M-of-N). Optional; absent means 1.

timeout.description: Seconds after created_at at which the Default fires. Upper bound keeps timeout*1000 within a 32-bit millisecond timer.

default.description: The decision that fires at the deadline if nobody answers.

callback.description: Optional URL the Countersignature is POSTed to, or null.

signature.description: base64url ed25519 signature by agent.public_key over the canonical envelope without this field (86 chars, no padding).
